Read the 5-day composites

Source: R/read.R
fpc_composites.Rd

Reads the field x 5-day composites of HLS reflectance and indices, Sentinel-1 backscatter and PRISM weather. date is the first day of each 5-day period.

Usage

fpc_composites(
  fields = NULL,
  vars = NULL,
  years = NULL,
  from = NULL,
  to = NULL,
  observed_only = TRUE,
  long = FALSE,
  dir = NULL
)

Arguments

fields

Field identifiers ("FPC000123"), or a data frame from fpc_fields(). NULL reads all fields (large: about 4.6 million rows per year).

vars

Variables to read (see fpc_variables()). NULL reads all. n_optical_obs, gap_filled and n_radar_obs are always included.

years

Years to read. NULL reads every year that is in the data folder.

from, to

First and last date (Date or "YYYY-MM-DD") of the periods to keep.

observed_only

Set gap-filled optical values to NA (see Details).

long

Return one row per field, date and variable (variable, value) instead of one column per variable.

dir

Data folder. Defaults to fpc_dir().

Value

A data frame with field_id, fid, date and the variables.

Details

Optical gaps of up to 30 days are filled in the release by linear interpolation between the observations on either side (gap_filled = TRUE, n_optical_obs = 0). Because an interpolated value depends on the next observation, it must not be used as an input of a forecast or any analysis that has to be causal. With observed_only = TRUE (the default) these optical values are set to NA; radar and weather values are kept.

Examples

d <- fpc_example_dir()
f <- fpc_fields(tier = "A", dir = d, geometry = FALSE)
x <- fpc_composites(f, vars = c("ndvi", "vv_db", "ppt_sum"), years = 2022, dir = d)
head(x)
#>    field_id   fid       date      ndvi     vv_db   ppt_sum n_optical_obs
#> 1 FPC060780 60780 2022-01-04 0.6175229 -12.54846  0.000000             2
#> 2 FPC060780 60780 2022-01-09        NA -11.51988  0.000000             0
#> 3 FPC060780 60780 2022-01-14 0.5940678 -11.15577 13.588799             2
#> 4 FPC060780 60780 2022-01-19        NA -11.90813  0.678800             0
#> 5 FPC060780 60780 2022-01-24        NA -12.44414  9.876699             0
#> 6 FPC060780 60780 2022-01-29 0.4648982       NaN  0.000000             2
#>   gap_filled n_radar_obs
#> 1      FALSE           1
#> 2       TRUE           1
#> 3      FALSE           1
#> 4       TRUE           1
#> 5       TRUE           1
#> 6      FALSE           0
